utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Tess — I’d be glad to help with the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I can check with a neighbor or two as well.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Rosa — that would be a huge help. If they can, tell them to come by the front porch this Saturday and I’ll put them to work!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I show up on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think we were saying Saturday morning on the front porch, but I should double-check the exact time. Just let me know what I should bring, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring basic tools and sturdy gloves this Saturday. Happy to help on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. That helps a lot, and I’ll be there on the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik. I’m still trying to pin down the helper list for Saturday on the front porch, so even one more person would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That helps a lot, Pia. I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so I’ll keep spreading the word for a few more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, I can still help this Saturday on the front porch—just tell me what to bring, and I’ll do my best to remember.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren. Just bring a few basic tools if you can, and I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam — I’m still rounding up a few helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, please send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send anyone handy your way. I’ll also be there on Saturday to help on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I show up on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking, Mina. Come by at 9 a.m. on the front porch this Saturday, and I’ll be there to get you started.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to line up enough helpers for Saturday on the front porch. If you can help, or know someone reliable, please let me know soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — I really appreciate it. I’m still hoping a few more people can pitch in on Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
